title: StudyHub Centralized Ethiopian Academic Taxonomy
description: Official centralized Ethiopian academic curriculum taxonomy for StudyHub, organizing study materials, past examinations, Ethiopian literature, and higher education courses across KG-Grade 12 and Ethiopian universities.

collections.name: Study Materials
collections.description: Textbooks, university modules, lecture notes, lecture slide presentations, worksheets, handouts, study guides, and comprehensive revision notes across all academic levels.

collections.name: Ethiopian Fiction & Reading
collections.description: Novels, children's books, folktales, poetry, and literature written in Ethiopian languages (Amharic, Afaan Oromo, Tigrinya, Somali, Afar) and English.

collections.name: Past Exams, Entrance & Exit
collections.description: School ministry examinations (Grade 8, Grade 12), regional exams, university midterms, final examinations, national exit exams, model papers, and solved past papers.

collections.name: University Freshman Courses
collections.description: National standardized freshman curriculum common modules, lecture notes, presentations, and examinations for Natural Science and Social Science streams across Ethiopian universities.

educationGroups.name: KG to Grade 8
educationGroups.description: Kindergarten, primary education (Grades 1–6), and middle school education (Grades 7–8) under the Ethiopian General Education curriculum.

educationGroups.name: Secondary Education
educationGroups.description: General secondary education (Grades 9–10) and preparatory secondary education (Grades 11–12), preparing students for national university entrance examinations.

educationGroups.name: University
educationGroups.description: Higher education, freshman common courses, undergraduate degree programs, and postgraduate studies across Ethiopian public and private universities.

educationGrades.name: Grade 9 (Secondary First Year)
educationGrades.note: Grade 9 belongs to Secondary Education. It is represented via grade metadata, NOT as an independent 22nd primary category.

subjectCategories.name: Languages & Literacy
subjectCategories.description: Amharic, English, Afaan Oromo, Tigrinya, Somali, Mother Tongue languages, reading and basic writing for primary and middle school.

subjectCategories.name: Mathematics
subjectCategories.description: Primary and middle school mathematics, arithmetic, number sense, fractions, basic geometry, algebra, and word problems.

subjectCategories.name: General & Environmental Science
subjectCategories.description: Integrated science, environmental science, primary biology, chemistry, and physics foundations for Grades 1–8.

subjectCategories.description: Primary social studies, Ethiopian geography, local communities, regional landscapes, and natural resources.

subjectCategories.description: Citizenship education, Ethiopian history, African history, national symbols, ethics, moral education, and social heritage.
